name: Sources
description: The external libraries, generators and galleries Cupric draws on — for the app interface and for the local HTML → MP4 generator. Each entry carries a prompt cue the brief builder can paste verbatim.
source: src/lib/sources.ts (links only; nothing third-party is bundled)

items.name: html-video
items.description: Apache-2.0 content-graph and multi-frame HTML-to-MP4 architecture: source ingestion, agent storyboard, deterministic browser capture and FFmpeg concat.

data.license: Apache-2.0; architecture referenced, no upstream runtime bundled
data.promptCue: Plan the video as a content graph: extract source facts, order them into explicit frames, give every frame editable text/data inputs, render deterministic HTML at a fixed fps, then concatenate and mux audio with FFmpeg.

items.name: Forge UI
items.description: Motion-first React components. Progress Stack and Stack Ripple are vendored into the Lab; Text Reveal and Velora drive HTML video templates.

data.promptCue: Forge UI look: soft neutral gradient cards (from-neutral-100 to-neutral-50, dark from-neutral-800 to-neutral-950), 12px radius, inset hairline ring, spring motion (damping 15, stiffness 200).

items.name: Forge UI templates
items.description: Full page templates used as scene layouts for HTML → MP4 renders (hero, pricing, feature grid).

data.promptCue: Template scene: full-bleed hero, one headline at 64px/800 weight, one supporting line at 22px muted, content centred in a 1080×1920 safe area.

items.name: Forge UI illustrations
items.description: SVG illustrations for empty states in the app and as foreground art in generated video.

data.promptCue: Line-art SVG illustration, single accent colour on a near-black field, 2px strokes, no gradients.

items.name: Watermelon UI
items.description: Playful animated React/Tailwind blocks — good source for Studio panel micro-states.

data.promptCue: Watermelon look: high-contrast rounded blocks, bouncy spring entrances, oversized type, one saturated accent.

items.name: shadcn/ui
items.description: The baseline primitive set and registry format every other source here plugs into.

data.promptCue: shadcn baseline: neutral tokens, 0.5rem radius, focus-visible ring, muted-foreground for secondary text.

items.name: Aceternity UI
items.description: 200+ animated React/Tailwind sections — spotlight cards, beams, aurora backgrounds.

data.promptCue: Aceternity look: aurora/beam background, spotlight that tracks the pointer, gradient borders, heavy blur.

items.name: Magic UI
items.description: Marquees, number tickers, shine borders — most of them map 1:1 to a video overlay.

data.promptCue: Magic UI look: shimmering border sweep, number ticker counting up, marquee row of logos at 40s linear.

items.name: Motion Primitives
items.description: Small, composable motion behaviours — the closest match to the Studio text animations.

data.promptCue: Motion primitive: per-character stagger of 0.03s, blur 6px → 0, y 12px → 0, easeOut 0.4s.

items.name: Uiverse
items.description: Community CSS-only buttons, loaders and toggles — pure CSS, so they drop straight into a render frame.

data.promptCue: CSS-only control, no JS: keyframes for the whole state change, hover and active handled in CSS.

items.name: Uiable
items.description: Curated Tailwind blocks; used as layout reference for the Library and Review Room.

data.promptCue: Clean Tailwind block: 12-column grid, generous 24px gaps, hairline dividers instead of shadows.

items.name: mapcn
items.description: Map, marker, route and popup components — the route-draw animation is a ready video beat.

data.promptCue: Map beat: dark tiles, a single lime route drawn with stroke-dashoffset over 2s, marker pops at each stop.

items.name: 21st.dev
items.description: Component registry that plugs in over MCP — the fastest way to pull one more block into the app.

data.promptCue: Registry install: shadcn add <item>, then restyle to Cupric tokens (near-black #0B0B10, lime #C8F542).

items.name: 23rd (shadcn registry)
items.description: Shader Gradient / Fire / Sky, Live Orb, ASCII Logo, Logo Burst, Radiant Lines, Dithered 404 — installs via shadcn CLI, renders as video atmosphere.

data.promptCue: Shader atmosphere behind content: full-bleed animated gradient in a relatively positioned, isolated section; UI sits in a later stacking context at z-10.

items.name: Beautiful UI
items.description: Polished marketing sections; used for spacing and type-scale reference.

data.promptCue: Editorial spacing: 96px section rhythm, 1.15 line-height headlines, -0.02em tracking.

items.name: MetalForge
items.description: Metallic/chrome material studies — the best reference for the liquid-glass and chrome-title looks.

data.promptCue: Chrome title: brushed metal gradient with an animated specular sweep, 1px dark inner bevel, no drop shadow.

items.name: Astryx
items.description: Meta-built component set — dense, accessible patterns worth copying for the app chrome.

data.promptCue: Astryx look: restrained neutral surfaces, strong focus states, 4px spacing grid, motion under 200ms.

items.name: Microkit
items.description: Micro-interactions — the small confirmations that make the Studio feel responsive.

data.promptCue: Micro-interaction: 120ms scale to 0.97 on press, 240ms spring back, haptic-style overshoot of 4%.

items.name: Glass refraction
items.description: Glass refraction study; feeds the existing Liquid Glass preset parameters.

data.promptCue: Liquid glass: backdrop blur 18px, SVG displacement 24, 1px white inner ring at 20%, specular highlight top-left.

items.name: Text Effects (Colorion)
items.description: Copy-paste CSS text effects — direct source for kinetic type beats.

data.promptCue: Text effect beat: gradient text with an animated background-position sweep over 2.4s linear infinite.

items.name: Kinetics (Colorion)
items.description: 150+ motion effects shipped with React code and a matching prompt for each.

data.promptCue: Kinetic effect: describe the motion in one clause (what moves, how far, over how long, with what easing).

items.name: Circle Loaders
items.description: Pure-CSS circular loaders — used for progress beats and the Render screen.

data.promptCue: Circular loader: 2px stroke, 270° arc, 1s linear rotation, accent stroke on a 12%-opacity track.

items.name: Gradient Buttons
items.description: Gradient button recipes for the primary CTA family.

data.promptCue: Gradient CTA: 135° two-stop gradient, 1px lighter top edge, shadow only on hover.

items.name: Kitbitz
items.description: 2,000+ hand-drawn illustrations — foreground art for video and empty states in the app.

data.promptCue: Hand-drawn illustration, ink linework, slightly wobbly strokes, flat single-colour fills.

items.name: 3dicons
items.description: Free 3D icons (PNG/Blend) — hero props for video beats and Library category art.

data.promptCue: 3D icon prop: soft clay material, single key light from top-left, 15° tilt, transparent background.

items.name: Anime.js
items.description: Timeline animation library — the natural driver for `__seek(t)` HTML video templates.

data.promptCue: Anime.js timeline seeked by frame: build the full timeline, then call tl.seek(t * 1000) per frame.

items.name: Gradientool
items.description: Gradient generator; exports CSS that drops into the backgrounds pack.

data.promptCue: Export as CSS `background-image` only, no vendor prefixes, sRGB stops.

items.name: Backgrounds Supply — Gradient Lab
items.description: Mesh gradient lab — full-bleed stage backgrounds for renders.

data.promptCue: Mesh gradient stage: 4 blurred colour blobs over #0B0B10, 120px blur, no visible banding.

items.name: Animos editor
items.description: Browser animation editor; its exported keyframes convert into Studio clips.

data.promptCue: Keyframe export: list of {t, props} pairs, linear between keys unless an easing is named.

items.name: Cutting Mat Generator
items.description: Self-healing cutting-mat grid — a distinctive SVG backdrop for product beats.

data.promptCue: Cutting-mat backdrop: dark teal field, 1cm white grid at 12%, 5cm grid at 24%, faint angle guides.

items.name: Space Type Generator
items.description: Type-in-space renders — ready-made title cards.

data.promptCue: Spatial title: letters distributed in depth, slow dolly-in, heavy tracking, monochrome.

items.name: Book of Shapes
items.description: Generative shape library — SVG accents and transition masks.

data.promptCue: Generative shape mask: one organic blob, used as a clip-path that grows from 0 to cover over 0.6s.

items.name: Tabbied patterns
items.description: Doodle-pattern generator; tiles as a looping background.

data.promptCue: Pattern backdrop: repeating doodle tile at 8% opacity, slow 60s diagonal drift.

items.name: Dotforge
items.description: Dot-matrix background generator — matches the existing Dot Field effect.

data.promptCue: Dot matrix: 1px dots on a 24px grid at 8% white, radial mask fading to transparent at the edges.

items.name: Ditther
items.description: Dithering tool — 1-bit treatments for retro beats and thumbnails.

data.promptCue: Dither pass: Atkinson dithering to 1-bit, then tint the white channel with the accent colour.

items.name: Tokokino
items.description: Motion-heavy showcase; reference for pacing and scene cuts.

data.promptCue: Pacing reference: cut on the beat every 1.2s, hold the final frame for 1.5s.

items.name: benday
items.description: Ben-Day halftone generator — print-style texture over stills.

data.promptCue: Halftone pass: 6px dot grid at 15°, two-colour separation, slight registration offset.

items.name: Spherium
items.description: Sphere/orb visuals — a drop-in hero object for opening beats.

data.promptCue: Orb hero: single iridescent sphere centred, slow rotation, rim light, dark vignette field.

items.name: designmd.ai
items.description: Design systems expressed as markdown an agent can read — the format Cupric briefs should follow.

data.promptCue: Give the agent the system as markdown: tokens, spacing scale, component rules, then the task.

items.name: Vibeprompts
items.description: Ready-made prompts for dashboards and landing pages — seeds for the Brief screen.

data.promptCue: Brief seed: audience, one promise, three proof beats, one call to action.

items.name: getlayers.ai
items.description: 200+ full build prompts for 3D and scroll-driven sites — complete briefs, not components.

data.promptCue: Full build brief: scene list, camera moves, scroll triggers, asset list, then the copy deck.

items.name: Minimal Gallery
items.description: High-end minimal sites — feed a URL to the agent as a style anchor.

data.promptCue: Style anchor: minimal, one typeface, one accent, whitespace doing the work.

items.name: Kage
items.description: UI inspiration mapped straight to prompts.

data.promptCue: Inspiration → prompt: name the layout, the motion, the palette, and the one detail that sells it.

items.name: Refero Styles
items.description: 2,000+ real product styles with typography specs — type scales worth stealing exactly.

data.promptCue: Type scale: name the family, the weights used, the scale ratio, and the tracking at display sizes.

items.name: The Component Gallery
items.description: 2,600+ ways top design systems solve the same element — the tiebreaker when a pattern is unclear.

data.promptCue: Pattern check: compare three systems solving this element, keep the simplest that stays accessible.

items.name: Appshot Gallery
items.description: App screenshot gallery — framing reference for product-shot beats.

data.promptCue: Product shot beat: device frame at 12° tilt, screen content readable, soft floor shadow.

items.name: Saved.design
items.description: Curated saves of interface and motion work — a running moodboard for the app.

data.promptCue: Moodboard cue: one adjective for the motion, one for the surface, one for the type.

items.name: PanelUI
items.description: 135 accessible React Native components (plus 21 chart visualisations) with unusually well-written behaviour docs. Catalogue vendored offline under resources/panelui.

data.promptCue: PanelUI behaviour rule: never fake a material that the platform does not have — draw a finished solid surface instead. Motion runs on the UI thread; every state has a real, reachable end state.

items.name: React Bits
items.description: Animated text effects, backgrounds and buttons, filed by animation type — the closest match to Studio text animations.

data.promptCue: React Bits style: one idea per effect, the whole animation expressible as a function of a single 0–1 progress value.

items.name: LottieFiles
items.description: Free animated stickers as Lottie JSON. The one asset class that needs no retrofit: lottie-web exposes goToAndStop(frame), so it is seekable by construction — exactly the Studio rule.

data.promptCue: Sticker beat: a small looping Lottie mark in a corner, entering on the cut and settling within 0.5s.

items.name: Rive
items.description: Interactive vector animations with state machines — heavier than Lottie, but the stickers can react.

data.promptCue: Rive-style mark: one state machine with idle → hover → active, each transition under 300ms.

items.name: Iconify
items.description: 200,000+ icons from every major set behind one component — no per-set dependency bloat.

data.promptCue: Icons: single-weight line icons at 1.5px stroke on a 24px grid, one family throughout.

items.name: unDraw
items.description: Free recolourable SVG illustrations — empty states in the app, explainer art in video.

data.promptCue: Illustration: flat vector scene recoloured to a single brand accent on a near-black field.

items.name: Blush
items.description: Mix-and-match illustration sets, recolourable to the brand palette.

data.promptCue: Character art: one figure, brand-palette fills, no gradients, generous negative space.

items.name: Storyset
items.description: Animated SVG illustration sets, exportable as Lottie or plain SVG.

data.promptCue: Animated illustration: loop under 4s, motion confined to two or three elements, the rest static.

items.name: Pexels Videos
items.description: Free stock footage, no attribution required — the default pool for suggested B-roll.

data.promptCue: B-roll: one continuous shot, slow camera move, subject off-centre so captions have room.

items.name: Pixabay Videos
items.description: Free stock footage and stills under a permissive licence.

data.promptCue: Stock shot: neutral colour, no on-screen text, room at the top third for a headline.

items.name: Mixkit
items.description: Free footage, music and SFX in one place — the quickest single source to wire up for background music.

data.promptCue: Music bed: instrumental, steady tempo, no vocal in the first 3 seconds so the hook lands clean.

items.name: Coverr
items.description: Free cinematic/lifestyle stock footage.

data.promptCue: Cinematic plate: shallow depth of field, warm key light, slow push-in.

items.name: Uppbeat
items.description: Creator-focused music library, free with credit — a direct answer to the background-music gap.

data.promptCue: Track choice: name the tempo, the mood in one word, and where the drop should land relative to the CTA.

items.name: Freesound
items.description: Huge SFX library — whooshes, clicks and risers for transition sound design.

data.promptCue: Transition SFX: a 300ms whoosh landing exactly on the cut, 6dB under the music bed.

items.name: Fontsource
items.description: Google Fonts as npm packages — self-hosted, so generated HTML stays inside the no-CDN rule. Cupric already ships Inter and JetBrains Mono this way.

data.promptCue: Type: self-hosted variable font only; never reference fonts.googleapis.com from a generated file.

items.name: Coolors
items.description: Palette generator with CSS-variable export — seeds new brand kits.

data.promptCue: Palette: one near-black base, one saturated accent, two neutrals. Nothing else.

items.name: Mesh gradient generators
items.description: Mesh gradient presets to seed the Studio mesh background group.

data.promptCue: Mesh preset: four stops max, all within 40° of hue of each other, over the near-black base.

items.name: Three.js
items.description: WebGL for the app itself. Deliberately NOT for Arena-generated HTML: those files must be self-contained and deterministic, and a model cannot author a 150KB library into one.

data.promptCue: In-app 3D only. For generated scenes use CSS 3D transforms instead — see the css-3d entry.

items.name: React Three Fiber + drei
items.description: Declarative Three.js, matching the rest of the component model if 3D lands in the app shell.

data.promptCue: Declarative scene: one camera, one key light, one rim light, everything else is material.

items.name: CSS 3D transforms
items.description: The 3D that actually fits the generated-HTML contract: perspective + rotateX/Y/Z + translateZ are pure functions of t, weigh nothing, and need no library.

data.promptCue: 3D beat without WebGL: set perspective on #scene, then drive rotateY/translateZ from t. Card flips, cube turns and parallax depth, all deterministic.

items.name: Poly Haven
items.description: Fully free HDRIs, textures and models, no attribution required.

data.promptCue: Lighting: studio HDRI, single dominant source, soft falloff.

items.name: Kenney
items.description: Free low-poly asset packs — closer to motion-graphics shapes than to realistic models.

data.promptCue: Prop: low-poly, flat-shaded, two-tone, no texture maps.

items.name: Sketchfab
items.description: Large free-with-attribution 3D model library.

data.promptCue: Hero model: single object, neutral pose, centred, no environment.

items.name: reactvideoeditor/remotion-templates
items.description: Free Remotion video templates — reference structure only. Cupric does not ship or depend on the Remotion runtime (see docs/PHASE1_LICENSING.md), so these are mined as ideas and layout metadata, not as embeddable packages.

data.promptCue: Remotion pattern: every animation is interpolate(frame, …) — a pure function of the frame, like __seek(t).

items.name: designcombo/react-video-editor
items.description: React + Remotion CapCut/Canva-style editor — the closest architectural sibling to Cupric. Read for timeline state shape and effect-registry structure.

data.promptCue: Editor architecture: one normalised timeline store, effects registered by id, preview and export share the renderer.

items.name: OpenCut
items.description: Open-source CapCut alternative (Next.js + Zustand, multi-track, real-time preview). Its own notes flag stickers/effects rendering and export as the unsolved part — useful calibration.

data.promptCue: Editor architecture: Zustand slices per concern (timeline, playback, media), preview panel decoupled from export.

items.name: OpusClip
items.description: Long-to-short repurposing with content-aware clipping, dynamic captions and AI reframing — the reference if Cupric adds a "drop in raw footage, get a short" mode.

data.promptCue: Repurposing pass: find the hook, cut to the payoff, reframe to 9:16 keeping the speaker on the thirds.

items.name: Web Speech API
items.description: Built-in speech recognition and synthesis. Cupric uses it for voice commands and for speak-a-brief; no dependency, no audio leaves the machine.

data.promptCue: Voice: one utterance in, one job out. Speak status back with SpeechSynthesisUtterance, never block on it.

items.name: Pipecat
items.description: Frame-based realtime voice-agent pipeline (VAD → STT → LLM → TTS). Deliberately not adopted: Cupric records one instruction and renders, it does not hold a conversation.

data.promptCue: Only worth its weight once mid-render conversation ("make the intro punchier") is a real requirement.

items.name: LiveKit Agents
items.description: WebRTC voice agents with ~450–600ms end-to-end targets — same verdict as Pipecat: a different problem than one-shot briefs.

data.promptCue: Reference only until Cupric needs duplex audio.
